title: Centre for Financial and Monetary Systems - Home
gist: Landing page of the WEF Centre for Financial and Monetary Systems listing initiatives on real-economy financing, longevity, retail investing and AI in financial services; promotional.

insights.claim: The Centre runs initiatives on financing the real economy transformation across infrastructure, heavy industry, transport, food systems and nature, plus longevity economy, global retail investing, and AI in financial services.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Shows policy-forum themes: retail participation and AI adoption guidance in finance.

insights.claim: The Centre says geopolitical conflicts disrupt the financial system and states increasingly use it for geoeconomic statecraft, while digitalization and democratization are transforming capital markets.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Financial-sanctions and fragmentation risk is a recognised institutional theme.

top_entities: Centre for Financial and Monetary Systems
